items.text: Postage for a domestic letter was 4 cents an ounce.
items.question: Where were you living when a stamp for a letter cost four cents, and who did you write to?

items.text: Chubby Checker took "The Twist", a number one in 1960, back to number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1962.
items.question: Who taught you to do the twist, and where were you dancing it?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart published since August 1958 by Billboard magazine which ranks the best-performing singles in the United States. In 1962, it was compiled based on a combination of sales and airplay data sourced from surveys of retail outlets and playlists submitted by radio stations respectively, and 21 different singles spent time at number one.
Chubby Checker (pictured with his wife Catharina Lodders in 1964) took his song "The Twist", a number one in 1960, back to the top spot in 1962.

items.text: On February 20, 1962, aboard Friendship 7, John Glenn became the first American to orbit the Earth.
items.question: Where were you when John Glenn went around the Earth, and who did you talk about it with?

items.text: The first Wal-Mart store opened for business in Rogers, Arkansas, on July 2, 1962.
items.question: Where did your family go to shop for everyday things in those years, and who did the shopping?
items.source_quote: July 2 – The first Wal-Mart store opens for business in Rogers, Arkansas.
